reactions.text: Good — now upgrade the evidence. P2 isn't secondhand anymore: Priya banked the same board deck twice and I caught it Tuesday, so grade P2 first-hand with that named, dated instance. Add the new one Maya raised: the duplicates corrupt the coverage bars and that nearly drove a bad call — we almost skipped a conversion session that was actually thin. And Maya conceded it's two things, so record that the one-thing-or-two dispute is settled. Ignore 'can we do mine first' — don't start sizing or sequencing; just frame the problems.
